claims.statement: Tom Allen and Mike McCoole agreed to fight in the prize ring on 13 September 1870, near St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: The Fight to Take Place onthe 13th

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Mike McCoole met at Coyne's saloon, Third Street, on 28 May 1870, each put up $500, and signed articles of agreement.
claims.excerpt: Each man put up $500, snd the following

claims.statement: The match between Tom Allen and Mike McCoole was made for $2,500 a side.

fights.excerpt: The Fight to Take Place onthe 13th
fights.notes: Match agreed on 1870-05-28 for 13 September 1870; the article reports the agreement, not a result. Year 1870 is from context.

notes: The articles of agreement text is not in the OCR. Coyne's saloon is not Allen's own saloon.
